title: Elevate UI Consistency: Master CSS 'font-synthesis' for Flawless Web Font Rendering
tweet: Prevent unwanted browser-generated bolds & italics! Master CSS 'font-synthesis' to ensure your web fonts render perfectly, maintaining visual consistency and a superior user experience. #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign
tip: To ensure your web fonts are always rendered as intended and prevent browsers from synthesizing bold or italic styles when a specific font weight/style is missing, explicitly set the 'font-synthesis' CSS property. Setting 'font-synthesis: none;' is often the best practice for critical UI elements, preserving design integrity and readability. This prevents the browser from creating 'fake' bold or italic versions, which can look amateurish or inconsistent with the font's design.
